dialogue.origin: （ロープレよろしくお願いします時間になりましたら開始させていただきます）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for participating in this role-play. We will begin when it's time.)

dialogue.origin: よろしくお願いします
dialogue.content: I look forward to it.

dialogue.origin: こんにちは、相談員です。ご相談にきていただいてありがとうございます
dialogue.content: Hello, I'm a counselor. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today.

dialogue.origin: 初めに、あなたの年齢、性別、今日相談したいことを教えてください
dialogue.content: To begin, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you would like to discuss today?

dialogue.origin: 15 男　何かしんどい
dialogue.content: 15, male. Feeling kind of worn out.

dialogue.origin: 何かしんどいとおもわれているのですねもう少し詳しく教えていただけますか？
dialogue.content: It sounds like you're feeling worn out about something. Could you tell me a bit more about it?

dialogue.origin: 何もやる気が起きない
dialogue.content: I don't feel motivated to do anything.

dialogue.origin: いつごろからそう感じますか？
dialogue.content: When did you start feeling this way?

dialogue.origin: 最近かな
dialogue.content: Recently, I guess.

dialogue.origin: 最近なのですね何か今までと変化があったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So it's been recent. Has anything changed for you?

dialogue.origin: 別にないかも
dialogue.content: Not really, I don't think so.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね１５歳ですと４月から高校に入学されたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. At 15, does that mean you started high school in April?

dialogue.origin: そうです
dialogue.content: Yes, that's right.

dialogue.origin: 新しい環境になられたのですね高校生活はいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So you're in a new environment. How is high school life going?

dialogue.origin: 楽しくない
dialogue.content: It's not fun.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですねどんなところが楽しくないのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. What parts of it aren't fun for you?

dialogue.origin: 友達もあんまりいないし、ノリがあわない
dialogue.content: I don't have many friends, and I don't really fit in with the vibe.

dialogue.origin: それはそう思うのも無理ないですね高校生活はどんなものを思い描いておりましたか？
dialogue.content: It's understandable that you feel that way. What did you imagine high school life would be like?

dialogue.origin: ん〜もう少し楽しい感じかな
dialogue.content: Hmm... I thought it would be a bit more fun, I guess.

dialogue.origin: なるほど新しい馬の合うお友達ができたら、もう少し楽しくなりそうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you think it might become more enjoyable if you made some new friends you get along with?

dialogue.origin: もうどうでもいいかな。行っても無駄だし。
dialogue.content: I don't really care anymore. It feels pointless to go.

dialogue.origin: そう思われるのですね他にも何か考えてしまうようなことがありますか？
dialogue.content: I understand you feel that way. Is there anything else that's been on your mind?

dialogue.origin: 学校辞めたい、家にもいたくない、しんどい。
dialogue.content: I want to quit school, I don't want to be at home either, and it's just exhausting.

dialogue.origin: 今はどこにもいたくないとおもわれるのですねおつらいですね
dialogue.content: It sounds like you feel you don't belong anywhere right now. That must be very difficult.

dialogue.origin: お家ではどんな環境なのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What is your home environment like?

dialogue.origin: 普通だと思いますよ。
dialogue.content: It's normal, I think.

dialogue.origin: 中学生のころとどんなところが変わったと感じますか？最近はコロナの影響もあってやりたいことがなかなかできない状況ですよね、、
dialogue.content: What feels different compared to when you were in middle school? Lately, with the impact of COVID, it's been hard to do what we want, right?

dialogue.origin: ん〜中学の頃はみんな仲良くて楽しかったかな〜
dialogue.content: Hmm, in middle school, everyone got along and it was fun, I guess.

dialogue.origin: 仲間と楽しい時間を過ごされていたのですね何か部活動などにははいられていたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: It sounds like you had a good time with your friends. Were you in any school clubs or activities?

dialogue.origin: バスケ
dialogue.content: Basketball.

dialogue.origin: バスケ部に入られていたのですね仲の良いお友達は部活関係の方が多かったのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So you were on the basketball team. Were most of your close friends from the team?

dialogue.origin: そうです。
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: 高校でもバスケは続けていらっしゃるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: Are you still playing basketball in high school?

dialogue.origin: やってません。
dialogue.content: No, I'm not.

dialogue.origin: 続けられない理由がなにかあったのかお聞きしても大丈夫ですか？
dialogue.content: Is it okay if I ask if there was a reason you didn't continue?

dialogue.origin: 仲良い子もいないしなんとなくやめよっかな〜って感じです。
dialogue.content: None of my close friends are on the team, and I just kind of felt like not continuing.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね中学に入りたての頃の自分はどんな思いで学校に通っていたか、部活を始めたか覚えていたりしますか？
dialogue.content: I see. Do you remember how you felt back when you first started middle school—about going to school and starting on the team?

dialogue.origin: あんまり覚えてないです。ノリです入った気がします。
dialogue.content: I don't really remember. I think I just joined for the fun of it.

dialogue.origin: ノリの合う仲間と出会って、楽しく始められたのかもしれないですね
dialogue.content: Maybe you met friends with a similar vibe and were able to have a fun start.

dialogue.origin: そうかもです。
dialogue.content: Maybe so.

dialogue.origin: どうしたらやる気が出ますか？
dialogue.content: How can I get motivated?

dialogue.origin: やる気をだしたいと思われているのですね
dialogue.content: So you would like to feel more motivated.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Yes.

dialogue.origin: どんなことにやる気をだしたいと思われますか？
dialogue.content: What kinds of things would you like to feel motivated about?

dialogue.origin: 全部かな。このままだと学校もやめそうです
dialogue.content: Everything, I guess. At this rate, I feel like I'm going to drop out of school.

dialogue.origin: そうすると、まずは学校を辞めたいと思わないような気持になれたらいいなぁと思うところでしょうか？
dialogue.content: So perhaps the first step would be to feel less like you want to quit school. Does that sound right?

dialogue.origin: そうですね〜
dialogue.content: Yeah, I suppose so.

dialogue.origin: 今の高校生活でも何か楽しいと感じるものや目標が見つかったら、またやる気が出てくるかもしれないですね
dialogue.content: If you could find something fun or a goal in your current high school life, maybe you would start to feel motivated again.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに、今の高校にはどんな理由で入ろうとおもわれたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: By the way, what was your reason for choosing your current high school?

dialogue.origin: なんとなく、成績で入れそうだったからです
dialogue.content: No real reason, just that my grades were good enough to get in.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですね高校の後は何かやりたいなぁと思われることはありますか？（これから考えていくものかとは思いますが、、）
dialogue.content: I see. Do you have anything you think you might want to do after high school? (I realize that's something you'll be thinking about from now on, though.)

dialogue.origin: ん〜別にないかも
dialogue.content: Hmm, maybe nothing in particular.

dialogue.origin: まだ高校生活のスタートですもんねこれからいろいろ発見がありそうですね
dialogue.content: Well, you're just at the start of your high school life. It seems like there will be many discoveries to come.

dialogue.origin: 今の高校のクラスはどんな雰囲気ですか？
dialogue.content: What's the atmosphere like in your current class?

dialogue.origin: ん〜ノリが違うかな。
dialogue.content: Hmm, the vibe is different, I guess.

dialogue.origin: どんなノリだと居心地が良いと感じるのでしょうか？逆に今はどんなところが違うと感じるのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: What kind of vibe feels comfortable for you? And conversely, what feels different about the current one?

dialogue.origin: 何かみんな真面目かな。ちょっとついていけない感じ。
dialogue.content: Everyone seems kind of serious. I feel like I can't quite keep up.

dialogue.origin: まじめな方が多いと感じられるのですね高校が始まって１か月ちょっとですね、、もしかしたら、まだ本当の自分が出せていない方もいるかもしれないですね
dialogue.content: So you feel like there are a lot of serious people. It's only been a little over a month since high school started... It's possible that some people haven't shown their true selves yet.

dialogue.origin: そうなんですかね
dialogue.content: You think so?

dialogue.origin: あなたのような同じ気持ちの方も中にはいるかもしれないですね一見まじめなような方が多くても、同じような趣味を持つ方がいたらお話しが弾みそうだと思うのですがいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: There might be others who feel the same way you do. Even if many seem serious at first glance, if you found someone with similar hobbies, I think the conversation would flow, don't you?

dialogue.origin: ほとんど話したことないからわからないですけど
dialogue.content: I haven't really talked to anyone, so I don't know.

dialogue.origin: そうかもしれませんね
dialogue.content: But maybe you're right.

dialogue.origin: これからお話ししていく中で、様々なキャラクターの方が見つかるかもしれないですね教室では気軽に話せるような環境にありますか？
dialogue.content: As you start talking to people, you might find all sorts of different personalities. Is the classroom an environment where you can talk freely?

dialogue.origin: あんまり教室にはいませんね。
dialogue.content: I'm not in the classroom much.

dialogue.origin: 他のクラスか食堂にいます
dialogue.content: I'm usually in another classroom or the cafeteria.

dialogue.origin: そうなのですね話せるタイミングがあると良いですよね、、ちなみに、バスケの部活動の見学はされたのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. It would be good if you had a chance to talk... By the way, have you gone to see the basketball team practice?

dialogue.origin: 見てないです
dialogue.content: No, I haven't.

dialogue.origin: 部活動でしたら、「バスケが好き」と同じ気持ちを持った方々がいると思うのですが、どうなのでしょうか？
dialogue.content: On the team, I'd think you'd find people who share that same feeling of "I love basketball." What do you think about that?

dialogue.origin: ん〜今更無理かな〜
dialogue.content: Hmm, it's probably too late now.

dialogue.origin: そう思われるのですねでは、もし、またやりたいなと思う時が来たら、機会があったらですかね他に少しでも興味をもった部活は何かありましたか？
dialogue.content: You feel that way, I see. Well, maybe if you feel like you want to play again, when the opportunity arises. Were there any other clubs that you were even slightly interested in?

dialogue.origin: なかったですどれも面白くなさそうだったんで
dialogue.content: No, none of them seemed interesting.

dialogue.origin: そうだったのですねちなみに、同じクラスでなくても、他のクラスや食堂にはノリが合いそうな方は見つかりそうでしょうか？
dialogue.content: I see. By the way, even if they're not in your class, do you think you could find people you'd get along with in other classes or the cafeteria?

dialogue.origin: あったことはないけれど、SNSで見つけて、この人気が合いそうとかでも良いと思いますよ
dialogue.content: Even if you haven't met them, you could find someone on social media and think, "I might get along with this person." I think that's fine too.

dialogue.origin: SNSですか〜なるほど。でも余計に学校行きたくなくなるかもですが。試してみます。
dialogue.content: Social media, huh? I see. That might make me want to go to school even less, but I'll give it a try.

dialogue.origin: もしやってみて、気分が落ちてしまいそうでしたらやめてしまってよいと思いますあなたのペースですすんでいきましょう
dialogue.content: If you try it and feel like it's bringing your mood down, I think it's perfectly fine to stop. Let's go at your own pace.

dialogue.origin: ちなみに学校以外で
dialogue.content: By the way, outside of school...

dialogue.origin: そうですかねやる気出てきますかね？
dialogue.content: Do you think so? Do you think I'll get my motivation back?

dialogue.origin: 何かリラックスできることや楽しめるものはありますか？
dialogue.content: Is there anything you do to relax or enjoy yourself?

dialogue.origin: 音楽聞くぐらいかな〜
dialogue.content: I guess just listening to music.

dialogue.origin: 無理してやる気をだそうと思わなくても良いと私は思いますよ中学から高校に行くのは本当に大きな変化で、体や心に予想以上に負荷がかかっている状況だと思います
dialogue.content: I don't think you need to force yourself to be motivated. Moving from middle school to high school is a really big change, and I think it's putting more strain on your mind and body than you might realize.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 音楽をきいて心が少しでも軽くなるならば是非この時間を今は大事にすごされてみてはいかがでしょうか？
dialogue.content: If listening to music helps your heart feel even a little lighter, why not cherish that time for now?

dialogue.origin: そうしてみます
dialogue.content: I'll try that.

dialogue.origin: また、気持ちがわいてきた時に、少しずつ前に進めばよいように感じますあなたはそのままで大丈夫です
dialogue.content: Then, when you feel up to it again, I think it's fine to move forward little by little. You are fine just as you are.

dialogue.origin: そろそろ相談を終わりにしたいと思うのですが他に何かお話しされていことはありますか？
dialogue.content: I think it's about time to wrap up our session. Is there anything else you'd like to talk about?

dialogue.origin: ないです
dialogue.content: No.

dialogue.origin: また、何かありましたら是非ご相談にいらしてくださいね今日はご相談にきていただいて、ありがとうございましたそれでは相談を終了させていただきます
dialogue.content: If anything else comes up, please feel free to come and talk anytime. Thank you for coming in for a consultation today. I will now end our session.

dialogue.origin: はい
dialogue.content: Okay.

dialogue.origin: 失礼いたします
dialogue.content: Take care.

dialogue.origin: ありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you very much.

dialogue.origin: （ロープレにお付き合いいただいてありがとうございました）
dialogue.content: (Thank you for participating in the role-play.)

dialogue.origin: こちらこそありがとうございました。
dialogue.content: Thank you as well.

topic.sub: 高校生活のストレスと友人関係の悩み
